name: Stable Mint EUR
oneLiner: EURSM is Stable mint Ltd's euro token, backed by cash and liquid financial assets and redeemable at par after holder onboarding.
collateral: Issuer-disclosed euro cash deposits and high-quality liquid financial assets; asset weights, bank allocation and independently reconciled backing remain unverified.
pegMechanism: Holders may redeem at par after onboarding, token return and AML/KYC screening. No issuer redemption fee or minimum applies; third-party bank charges may apply. Issuance is against received fiat deposits.

proofOfReserves.provider: Stable mint Ltd; 102% reserve claim without a retrieved dated reserve-to-liability reconciliation

launchPhaseDetail: Publicly issued on Etherlink; awaiting an admitted price lane.

milestones.title: Stable Mint announces live EURSM issuance
milestones.description: Stable mint Ltd announces that it is live and issuing euro and dollar electronic-money tokens with segregated reserves and par redemption.

listingStatusReview.reason: No admitted price lane: exact-contract DefiLlama quote is empty and no verified CoinGecko listing was found. Positive Etherlink supply is verified.
